# EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER

[Company Letterhead]

Date: [DATE]

[Candidate Name]
[Address]
[City, State ZIP]

Dear [Candidate Name],

We are pleased to extend an offer of employment for the position of **Senior Software Engineer** at [COMPANY NAME]. We believe your skills and experience will be valuable additions to our engineering team.

## Position Details

**Title:** Senior Software Engineer
**Department:** Engineering
**Reports To:** [VP of Engineering / Engineering Manager Name]
**Location:** [Office Location / Remote / Hybrid]
**Start Date:** [Proposed Start Date]
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

## Responsibilities

In this role, you will:
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend/frontend systems using [primary tech stack, e.g., Python, TypeScript, Go, React]
- Lead technical design discussions and code reviews for complex features
- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on best practices
- Collaborate with Product, Design, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable, high-quality software
- Improve system performance, reliability, and observability
- Participate in on-call rotation and incident response as needed

## Compensation

**Base Salary:** $[AMOUNT] per year, paid [bi-weekly/semi-monthly/monthly] in accordance with the Company's standard payroll practices, subject to applicable withholdings.

**Bonus:** Eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus of up to [X]% of base salary, based on company and individual performance. Bonus payments are at the Company's sole discretion and require active employment at the payment date.

**Equity:** [X shares of stock options, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, subject to the terms of a separate Stock Option Agreement / Not applicable]

**Sign-On Bonus:** [$AMOUNT, paid [lump sum upon start / in equal installments over X months], subject to repayment if employment ends within [X] months / Not applicable]

## Benefits

You will be eligible for our standard benefits package, including:
- Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) effective [date]
- 401(k) with [X]% company match
- [X] days paid time off per year
- [X] paid holidays
- Life and disability insurance
- Professional development budget of $[X] per year
- [Other benefits, e.g., home office stipend, commuter benefits]

Full details will be provided during onboarding.

## Contingencies

This offer is contingent upon:
- Successful completion of a background check
- Verification of your right to work in [Country]
- Execution of required employment documents including:
  - Confidentiality Agreement
  - Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement
  - [Non-Compete Agreement, if applicable]

## At-Will Employment

Please note that employment with [Company Name] is at-will. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. This offer letter does not constitute a contract of employment for any specific period.

## Acceptance

To accept this offer, please sign below and return by [DEADLINE DATE]. This offer will expire if not accepted by that date. If you have any questions about this offer, please contact [HR Contact] at [email/phone].

We are excited about the possibility of you joining our team and look forward to the impact you will make.

Sincerely,

_________________________
[Hiring Manager Name]
[Title]
[Company Name]

---

## ACCEPTANCE

I accept this offer of employment and agree to the terms stated above.

Signature: _________________________

Printed Name: _________________________

Date: _________________________

Anticipated Start Date: _________________________

---

**Customization notes:**
- Replace all bracketed `[placeholders]` with company-specific details (dates, amounts, tech stack, location).
- **Non-compete clauses** have limited enforceability in many jurisdictions — confirm applicability before including one.
- The **At-Will** provision should be reviewed for states where it may not apply as written.
- If this is a contract/fixed-term engagement rather than at-will employment, use the Employment Agreement template from the skill instead.

**Disclaimer:** This template is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. Consult with qualified legal counsel before using this document.
